faq.title: FAQ
q1a: No. The bot explains and teaches: it shows every step and the rule behind it, so you can solve the next problem yourself.
q2a: Mathematics, English, physics, chemistry and history — and in general any school question you are stuck on.
q3a: Nine languages: Russian, English, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Indonesian, Turkish, Vietnamese and Ukrainian. Switch any time with /lang.
q4a: With Telegram Stars, right in the chat. The first 5 breakdowns are free; after that you can buy a single breakdown or a pack.
q5: Do I need to install anything?
q5a: No. It works inside Telegram — on your phone or computer.
q6a: Stars (⭐) are Telegram's built-in currency. You top them up once inside Telegram — the app offers the usual payment (card, App Store or Google Play) — and then pay for breakdowns right in the chat. No subscription and no auto-renewal: you only pay when you choose to. Telegram Premium is not required.
q7a: Right in the chat: when you tap to buy a breakdown, Telegram opens the payment window and offers to top up your Stars balance if it's low. The balance stays in your Telegram account and works in any bot that accepts Stars.
q8: How long does a breakdown take?
q8a: Usually under a minute: send your task and the breakdown comes back in the chat — typically in 10–60 seconds.
q9a: Try again in a few minutes — brief overloads happen. If it keeps failing, write to us via the contact form below — we will look into it.
q10: How is it different from a general AI chatbot?
q10a: Unlike a general chatbot, it follows a teaching method: every breakdown explains the steps, and for solutions the bot stops one step before the answer so you finish it yourself. Your tasks also stay on our own server — they are not sent to third-party AI services.
